name: Threshold Basis 1 Code
definition: Nature of the quantity used as a basis to set a threshold for voting on resolutions at general meetings.

ALSH.name: All Issued Shares
ALSH.definition: Basis is the total number of shares issued.

ALSM.name: All Shares Represented At Meeting
ALSM.definition: Basis is the total number of shares represented at the meeting by attendees.

ALVO.name: All Vote Cast
ALVO.definition: Basis is the total number of vote cast for a resolution.
